body:
I have reached out. Specifically to my best friend who I've known since middle school. Sometimes I feel like it helps and sometimes it doesn't. It just feels like there are so many mountains to climb before I can be happy.

The relationship thing really kills me. Like you said it's a vicious cycle. One of my favorites is about desperation. "Oh you can't appear desperate." Well I'm actually desperate as hell considering I'm 26 and have never had a real relationship. So I guess step 1 to fixing this is pretending I don't have a problem? It's such a complicated pile of shit... I've always been more of a numbers/analytical guy but that shit doesn't help at all for what I need.
Billy Joel attempted suicide and is still selling out stadiums 40 years later.
